pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with high-frequency jagged edges and sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area is largest on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries toward the posterior and lower belly.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored topological graph with well-defined three-way and four-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively narrow and consistent across the mid-flank, with slight widening at nodal points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck mane, transitioning into a smoother 1D contour over the shoulder and dorsal ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized region of de-pigmentation and textural smoothing is visible on the upper mid-flank, characterized by a loss of distinct patch-corridor boundaries and a hazy, light-gray pixel value.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The de-pigmented region on the upper flank displays characteristics of a healed lesion or chronic skin condition, disrupting the primary pelage pattern.
